fullContentHtml:
Bihar STET Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released a Notification for the Bihar State Teacher Eligibility STET Examination 2026 on the official website of the BSEB.  Applications for the Bihar STET Online Form 2026 has Started from 17 August 2026 & Candidate can apply untill 15 September 2026 (Extended). Candidates can Check full details of Bihar STET Online Form 2026 which given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 August 2026
  • Last Date : 15 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 15 September 2026
  • Exam Start : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam
  • Result : will be updated here soon

Application Fee

  • Paper I or Paper II
  • General, EWS, BC, EBC :  Rs. 960/-
  • Other State (All Category) :  Rs. 960/-
  • SC, ST, PWD :  Rs. 760/-
  • Both Paper I & II
  • General, EWS, BC, EBC:  Rs. 1440/-
  • Other State (All Category):  Rs. 1440/-
  • SC, ST, PWD : Rs. 1140/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Bihar STET Online Form 2026?

Bihar STET Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 15 September 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
